 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAURABH BANERJEE  ORDER % 18.12.2023 1.

The petitioners, vide the present petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seek quashing of FIR No.0477/2022 dated 13.07.2022 registered under Section(s) 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Punjabi Bagh, West District, Delhi and all proceedings emanating therefrom in view of the Memorandum of Understanding dated 14.08.2023 arrived at between the parties.
2.
This petition is accompanied by the Memorandum of Understanding dated 14.08.2023 and is also supported by affidavits of all the petitioners This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 01:10:46 and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3.
Petitioner nos.1 to 4 and as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
5. Learned APP accepts notice.
He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 28.11.2023.

She further affirms the Memorandum of Understanding dated Jasjeev Singh Kohli & Ors vs The State Nct Of Delhi And Anr on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192636566/
1 14.08.2023 whereby the petitioner no.1 has already returned the articles belonging to the respondent no.2 in full and final settlement of all her claims including alimony, maintenance (present, past and future), stridhan etc.
